observations: Five handbags in different colors: yellow, red, brown, black, and grey.
Orange boxes in the background feature the 'HERMES' logo and labels.
The bags have 'HERMES PARIS' gold-tone stamps on the front flap area.
Handles are wrapped in white protective paper or plastic.
Each bag has a decorative horse-shaped charm attached to the handle.
A watermark 'REN WHOLESALE AND VARIETIES' is visible across the image.

claims.evidence: Standard seller statement; photos only show one side of the items.
Subjective; 'affordable' is highly inconsistent with the brand name shown.

risks.proof: High-resolution close-up of the 'Hermes Paris Made in France' heat stamp, hardware engravings, and stitching patterns.
Close-up photo of the leather grain and the edges of the straps to check for synthetic layers.
Photos of the interior lining, pockets, and any internal branding/date codes.
risks.if_unproven: as having basic or low-quality lining

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the heat stamp on the front of the bag.
Photo of the interior of one of the bags.
Close-up of the hardware, specifically the lock and the base of the handles.
Photo of the bottom of the bags to see the feet and stitching.
response.reason: The items are clearly identified by brand and style. Due to the 'wholesale' context and lack of authenticity evidence, they are priced as non-authentic replicas.
